# Inference

Inference runs a trained model over a scene in overlapping tiles and blends the result. Two engines exist; the page on the
[other inference engine](../../inference/engine.md) explains why.

**Explained in:** [Inference](../../inference/index.md) · [Tiles, overlap and seams](../../inference/tiles.md)

This page documents **14 public classes and functions** in 9 modules.

## `pygeovision.inference.tiled`

Tiled inference with Gaussian blending (B1, B4, B5). Handles arbitrarily large GeoTIFFs without memory overflow. Uses smooth Gaussian window weighting at tile boundaries.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `GaussianBlend` | class | Gaussian blend window for seamless tile stitching (B1). |
| `TiledInference` | class | Memory-efficient tiled GeoTIFF inference with Gaussian boundary blending (B1-B5). |
